description: This is a Python source file defining classes and functions for object detection using the ImageAI library. It includes support for models like RetinaNet, YOLOv3, and TinyYOLOv3, and provides methods for detecting objects in images and videos, as well as configuring custom object detection settings.

classes.name: ObjectDetection
classes.description: Class providing support for object detection in images using RetinaNet, YOLOv3, and TinyYOLOv3 models, with methods to configure models, load weights, and perform detection.

classes.name: VideoObjectDetection
classes.description: Class supporting object detection in videos and live streams, with methods to configure models, load weights, and perform detection with callback functions.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsRetinaNet
methods.description: Sets the model type to RetinaNet for object detection.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsYOLOv3
methods.description: Sets the model type to YOLOv3 for object detection.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsTinyYOLOv3
methods.description: Sets the model type to TinyYOLOv3 for object detection.

methods.name: setModelPath
methods.description: Sets the file path to the model weights file.

methods.name: loadModel
methods.description: Loads the specified model with optional detection speed configuration.

methods.name: detectObjectsFromImage
methods.description: Detects objects in an image, returning detection details and optionally saving or returning object images.

methods.name: detectCustomObjectsFromImage
methods.description: Deprecated method for detecting custom objects in images, redirects to detectObjectsFromImage.

methods.name: CustomObjects
methods.description: Creates a dictionary to specify which objects to detect, used with custom object detection methods.

methods.name: detectObjectsFromVideo
methods.description: Detects objects in a video or live stream, with support for callback functions and saving output video.

methods.name: detectCustomObjectsFromVideo
methods.description: Deprecated method for detecting custom objects in videos, redirects to detectObjectsFromVideo.
